Description: This scenario describes the scenario contents for the SA basic call procedure.
Warning: This file only performs basic operations and may affect the entire TC referencing it. Make sure to perform the entire TC after modification. Also, please control FOO and Option at each TC.

tc_filter.description1: It allows you to run only the TCs you want out of many TCs.
tc_filter.description2: If you want an accurate match of the tc name and filter, set range_check to 0
tc_filter.description3: It is unnecessary to turn on/off the Skip of all TCs to prevent incorrect check-in.
tc_filter.description4: Always set tc_filter_use to 0 when checking in.

msg.#desc: If you want to change the information passed to InitialContextSetupRequest, you can modify it here. (CAPA must not be included.)
If you want to change the UE CAPA, you can modify this area.
